caption: The drawing depicts the front facade of a building rendered in grayscale tones. The structure features a large, arched wall with a rounded top, highlighted by bold outlines. At the center above the doorway, there is a decorative quatrefoil window with a geometric flower-like motif, containing both curved and angular elements. The doorway below is rectangular with a rounded arch at its top, and is framed by columns on each side as well as ornate architectural detailing, including a horizontal band above the arch with repeated decorative shapes and two small finials on either end. The composition only shows the front portion of the building, with the right and left sides fading into partial shadows. Below the drawing, a ribbon-shaped banner contains the date "1770" and beneath that, a wider banner bears the text "Mision San Carlos de Borromeo de Carmelo." The entire illustration is created using black and gray pencil or ink on a lightly textured, off-white background.
title: Mision San Carlos de Borromeo de Carmelo
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
